name: v0.17.1
body:
## What's Changed

### New features
* feat(evaluators): add hit@k attack success rate metric by @stefanoamorelli in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2090
  This new metric is currently exposed as terminal output and available per probe/detector pair in the final digest entry of the report.jsonl
* Add Python 3.14 support by @NK-Works in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2297

### Improved plugins
* fix(detectors): match mitigation.Prefixes at the start of the response by @chiruu12 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2067
* fix(detectors): stop FileDetector scoring an unexamined file as a pass by @CTWalk in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2080
* fix(detectors): stop RefusalOnlyAdversarial over-counting skipped multi-turn attempts by @Yigtwxx in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2111
* fix(detectors): scope safe-token suppression to its own match by @feiiiiii5 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2182
* fix(detectors): Scope ApiKey safe-token suppression to the matching credential by @MRX-72 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2270
* fix(detectors): Do not treat octal 27 as a raw ANSI escape by @SashaMIT in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2255
* fix(probes): keep promptinject settings aligned with sampled prompts by @reeve25 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2260
* fix(probes): restore DAN prompt compatibility by @patriciapampanelli in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2282

### Documentation
* docs(rest): document updated CLI syntax and generator_options schema by @NK-Works in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2279

### Tuning & fixes
* fix(generators): raise clear error on HF InferenceAPI 404 response by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2112
* fix(buffs): use prompt setter in paraphrase buffs to update conversations by @bodapatisaikrishna in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2200
* fix: deep-copy mutable attempt state in Buff._derive_new_attempt by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2156
* fix(buffs): preserve attempt attributes and isolate mutable state in _derive_new_attempt by @bodapatisaikrishna in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2198
* fix: reuse the WebSocket event loop across calls by @Vamsi-2581 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2269
* fix: respect parallel_capable for generator requests by @denelbjohn18 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2274
* probes: factor up local prompt-cap logic into probes.base by @VishnuR23 in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2085
* task: update deps for security hygiene by @jmartin-tech in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2311
* lock transformers due to interface changes by @jmartin-tech in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2316
* Use --target_name as the WebSocket generator uri by @Somay-kousis in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2315
* report: update report probe tooltip text to be accurate (higher=better) by @leondz in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2317

* @NK-Works made their first contribution in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2297
* @chiruu12 made their first contribution in https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/2067
